description: D3 (decision D3-2): the growth to stage 9. Once the Stormcaller has fallen (boss.stormcaller.defeated: stage 9's own requirement, growth_09's growth_requirement) the Rimstone answers a giant of level 17 again: grow to stage 9 (116 ft) at it. A save that had slain him before D3 starts it on its first load. Then the Fallen King's crown-iron on his standing shin is in reach (world.hoarfell.fallen_king_shin: requires stage 9).

stages.objective: Grow to stage 9 at the Rimstone
stages.waiting_text: The Rimstone stands on its rise west of the Fallen King, beyond the rim. With the storm broken it will grow a giant of level 17 to the height of the old kings' greatest.
